Edible Gardens • Plant Growing • Practical Gardening Support

🌱 Soul to soil. Garden to plate. Planting seeds of change.

Sonja is the founder of Dopamine & Dandelions, a growing project inspired by a love of plants, learning through experience and reconnecting with the simple joys of growing.

What began in a suburban backyard with a few pots of herbs, plenty of curiosity and a willingness to learn, has grown into a space dedicated to helping everyday people discover the rewards of gardening. 

Her philosophy is refreshingly down-to-earth: you don't need a huge backyard, expensive equipment or years of experience to start growing something beautiful or useful.

Through Dopamine & Dandelions, Sonja explores the connection between growing plants, creating a more grounded lifestyle and developing practical skills that can be used in everyday life.


🌿 What Sonja Offers:

Edible Gardens & Growing Food
Discover the possibilities of growing your own herbs, vegetables and other edible plants, whether you have a backyard, a courtyard, a balcony or just a few pots.

Practical Garden Support
Get inspiration and practical guidance to help you start growing, make the most of your available space and build confidence in caring for plants.

Plants, Cottage Flowers & Indoor Greenery
Explore plants that bring life, colour and purpose to your home and garden, from useful edible plants to cottage flowers and indoor favourites.

Small-Space Gardening & Plant Propagation
Learn how to make the most of the space you have, experiment with propagation and find creative ways to grow more using what is already available.

Creative, Sustainable Gardening
Discover ways to reuse materials, reduce waste, save money and build useful gardening skills over time.

Community, Workshops & Shared Knowledge
Dopamine & Dandelions embraces the idea that gardening is better when knowledge is shared. Its wider vision includes workshops, collaborations and opportunities to learn from others working across areas such as permaculture, hydroponics and beekeeping.


🌻 A Different Approach to Growing

Sonja's approach is about making gardening feel achievable rather than overwhelming. There is room to experiment, make mistakes, celebrate small wins and learn as you go.

Working with plants can offer a welcome opportunity to slow down, reconnect with nature and nurture something over time. Alongside these personal rewards, growing at home can help build practical skills, reduce waste and create opportunities to enjoy fresh food straight from the garden.

Whether you're just beginning your gardening journey or looking for fresh inspiration for your home and outdoor space, Dopamine & Dandelions encourages you to start where you are and grow at your own pace.

You don't need perfect conditions. You just need to start. 🌱
